  echo "$name: $info"
done

args.CommandLine:
python3 -c '
import subprocess, json

runs = [
    ("Main (eac2e5a)", "40553229464"),
    ("PR #268 (2cf9e99)", "40551894770"),
    ("PR #277 (54d0f9f)", "40547553194")
]

for label, run_id in runs:
    out = subprocess.check_output(["gh", "run", "view", run_id, "--json", "jobs"])
    data = json.loads(out)
    print(f"=== {label} (Run {run_id}) ===")
    for job in data.get("jobs", []):
        jname = job.get("name")
        jstatus = job.get("status")
        jconc = job.get("conclusion")
        steps = job.get("steps", [])
        active_step = next((s["name"] for s in steps if s.get("status") == "in_progress"), None)
        last_done = [s["name"] for s in steps if s.get("status") == "completed"]
        last_done_name = last_done[-1] if last_done else "None"
        print(f"  - {jname}: status={jstatus} conclusion={jconc} active_step={active_step} (last_done={last_done_name})")
'
